title: Roadmap tether briefing — crossfunc alignment notes
content:
Purpose
Quick sync to lock the roadmap tether points between Product, Serving Runtime, and Applied ML ahead of the exec readout. We want a single view of what is negotiable vs nonnegotiable (latency SLOs, quantization timeline, Dedicated capacity commitments).

Meeting objectives (30m)
- Surface any blocking technical risks that would shift Q2 rollouts.
- Agree on two prioritization levers we can commit to: (A) model family pinning for Hosted API, (B) targeted quantization pilot for high-volume tenants.
- Decide on experiment gating criteria (perf delta, quality regression threshold, rollback plan).

Pre-reads (please skim)
- Applied ML PRD (one-pager): Confluence:INF-Quantization-Pilot (attached)
- Serving runtime perf summary: internal dashboard snapshot (GITHUB:repo/infra#678)
- Product proposal: hosted-model-routing-v0 (JIRA:ENGINF-1213)

Agenda (timeboxed)
1) 0-5m: Quick status from each lead (Product / Serving Runtime / Applied ML) — 1 slide each
2) 5-15m: Technical constraints walk-through (latency budgets, KV cache implications, memory/throughput tradeoffs)
3) 15-25m: Prioritization discussion and commitment of two tether points (voting if needed)
4) 25-30m: Concrete action items and owners, plus meeting cadence going forward

Key context notes (brain-dump)
- Product goal: Enable 3 customer pilots on Dedicated by EOY with predictable per-token economics; Hosted API must not regress 99th percentile latency by >15ms for small seq workloads.
- Eng (runtime) constraints: Quantized 4-bit kernels are available but increase tail variance in some seq distributions. KV cache memory pressure needs an eviction policy change to avoid OOMs on multi-tenant hosts.
- Applied ML concerns: Certain safety/core-output checks have brittle behavior post-quantization; we need evaluation suites tied to prompt sets.

Open technical questions to raise
- Is canary-by-tenant for quantization viable on Hosted without infra changes? (runtime + product)
- Do we accept a temporary increase in 99th pct if we launch a quantized path that reduces median token cost by 18%? Define rollback threshold.
- What is the minimum telemetry to collect during pilot to be confident (latency, token quality score, regression delta on key prompts)?

Proposed tether points (suggestion)
- Nonnegotiable: 99th pct latency SLO for Hosted API routes supporting PLG sign-up must stay within +15ms of baseline.
- Negotiable: Model family pinning window — Product can allow model swaps only after automated eval pass and a 48h canary on Dedicated.

Decision criteria (how we will decide)
- Quantization pilot: pass if (1) median cost reduction >=15% AND (2) end-to-end human-eval quality delta <=2% on key prompt set AND (3) 99th pct latency increase <=20ms.
- Model routing change: pass if telemetry shows no more than 1.5x error spike and rollback can be automated within 30 minutes.

Meeting script (what I will say)
- 00:00 "I want to surface minimal set of constraints that Product can plan against and the smallest set of technical guardrails Eng/ML need to avoid rework."
- 05:00 Ask runtime to sketch worst-case resource impact if we enable tenant canaries simultaneously across 5 high-volume customers.
- 12:00 Ask Applied ML for the minimum evaluation harness to detect quality regressions (bench + human sample size).

Risks & mitigations (short bullets)
- Risk: Hidden tail regressions after quantized rollout. Mitigation: gated canary + realtime regression alarms tied to prompt set evaluation.
- Risk: Capacity pressure on Dedicated if Dedicated autoscale is misconfigured. Mitigation: temporary burst cap & manual throttle until autoscaling tuning completes.
- Risk: Product timeline slip due to undetected tooling gaps. Mitigation: reserve two engineer-weeks for integration testing in April.

Concrete follow-ups (post-meeting action items)
- Oliver: draft short-run playbook for quantization canary (includes rollback steps) — due 2026-03-30
- Priya Nair (Applied ML): produce evaluation harness + baseline quality scores for the pilot prompts — due 2026-03-29
- Marco Ruiz (Serving Runtime): run memory/eviction simulation for multi-tenant KV cache with quantized models — due 2026-04-02
- Sofia Patel (Product): update customer pilot commitment doc and adjust marketing timeline if tether points change — due 2026-03-31
- All: join follow-up 45m sync on 2026-04-06 to review artifacts and gate decision

Notes to self (prep reminders)
- Print two slide versions: technical (for runtime) and one-pager for Product execs.
- Bring concrete numbers: baseline 99th pct latency, median token cost, and current KV cache footprint per host. I must ask Marco to have these on-screen.
- Keep language explicit about what Product can promise customers vs what needs further infra work.

Tone and expectations
- Keep the conversation pragmatic and constrained; avoid re-litigating earlier roadmap choices. We are aligning on "what we will ship in Q2" and what stays for Q3.

Bottom line (one sentence)
- Align on two tether commitments now (latency SLO and quantization pilot gate) so Product can finalize pilot offers and Eng/ML can plan the mitigation work.
